replies.body:
I think it was an alright suggestion, if you are able to add it, it would help out with catching some of the hackers/getting staff to come one, let me explain: I usually always leave forums up on another tab, because I like to check it every now and then, and often there is a hacker or two on the server and no mods, but some mods are on the forums, commenting etc...So if we added this messaging thing we could contact mods and tell them to come online.

PS: Just a suggestion.
